retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, multi-character ensemble composition featuring sharp-angled character designs against a neon-lit urban hellscape with a central glowing emblem.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, symmetrical character collage utilizing high-contrast cel shading, sharp geometric silhouettes, and a dual-tone neon lighting scheme of magenta and cyan.
coreVisualRelationships: Central protagonist framed by larger, looming antagonistic figures
Symmetrical arrangement of secondary characters flanking the center
Foreground framing using stylized, reaching silhouettes
Integration of a glowing, ornate title badge at the lower center
coreInvariants: Sharp, angular character silhouettes with pointed features
High-saturation magenta and cyan rim lighting
Flat cel-shaded coloring with minimal gradients

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central character is medium-scale in the middle ground, surrounded by larger-scale figures in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing, neon-bordered title badge at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central character, move upward to the large screen-like face, then spiral outward to the flanking characters and down to the title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is packed with characters and architectural details to create a sense of chaotic energy.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep magenta and purple for shadows and background atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Electric cyan for highlights, rim lighting, and energy effects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and red for character eyes and focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with extreme value contrast between dark shadows and glowing neon edges.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with Art Deco influences
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with sharp, squared-off terminals
Integrated decorative elements like dots and horizontal bars within the glyphs
Outer glow effect to simulate neon tubing
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stems extended to form key-like or architectural shapes
Crossbars replaced with circular or diamond motifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly stylized, glowing central logo paired with clean, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Ornate badge frame with jagged, electric edges
Keyhole and key motifs integrated into the badge
Horizontal divider lines with pulse-wave patterns

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, high-waisted Art Deco feel of the secondary text.
Provides the squared-off, wide-tracking industrial look for metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense character ensemble in a sharp-angled, cel-shaded cartoon style. Use a magenta and cyan color palette with heavy rim lighting. Include a central empty space at the bottom for a badge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a custom-lettered logo inside a jagged, glowing neon badge at the bottom center. Place widely-spaced geometric sans-serif text at the very top and bottom edges.

verificationChecks: Is the central logo glowing with a cyan neon effect?
Are the character silhouettes sharp and angular?
Is the color palette dominated by magenta and cyan?
Is the secondary text widely tracked and centered?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the central badge frame
mustRedesign: Exact building designs in the background
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is garbled or nonsensical
Check that the cyan rim lighting is consistent across all characters
Verify the central badge is the primary visual anchor
Confirm the sharp, angular aesthetic is maintained throughout
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a symmetrical character collage with a dual-tone neon lighting scheme and a central glowing geometric badge.
